Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the higher education coordinating board to develop a grant program to encourage training for students studying in the medical field to work with individuals with disabilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to encouraging training for medical students,nurses, and medical technicians and assistants to work with adultpatients with developmental disabilities; and adding a new section tochapter 28B.115 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.115RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state of Washington promotes improving medical services toadult individuals with developmental disabilities. Subject to theavailability of amounts appropriated for this specific purpose, medicalstudents at the University of Washington, nursing students at schoolsof nursing within the state of Washington, and special and technicalcare students at technical schools within the state of Washington wouldbenefit from specialized training and exposure to the unique care needsfor adults that are developmentally disabled. The board shall developa centralized program for grants for institutions for programs designedto develop training projects focused upon improvement of services toadult individuals with developmental disabilities. The board shalladminister the grant program in consultation with the department of p. 1 HB 1446health. The board shall report to the appropriate committees of thelegislature by December 1, 2010. The report must include informationregarding grants awarded under this section, as well as any otherefforts or progress in expanding or improving training for students intreating adult individuals with developmental disabilities.
